name: Rokan 12 ~Arisu-tachi no Chitsu to Kanshoku~
original_name: 炉姦12 ～アリスたちの膣と感触～
source:
Short encounters with 12 grade school girls. Each story and protagonist are separate.

First time sex with 9 year old 4th grader Kokomi
Rape at the Elementary School with 11 year old 5th grader Hiyori
Hurray Fundoshi with 10 year old 5th grader Hinata
Raped While Sleeping with 7 year old 2nd grader Aoi
Private Tutoring Session with 12 year old 6th grader Nina
Lolicon Reborn with 10 year old Tio
Gang Raped on Public Transportation with 8 year old 3rd grader Yachiho
Traditions of the Back Country Shrine with 11 year old 6th grader Misa
Going to the Public Bath with 9 year old 3rd grader Miu
The Orphanage at Night with 8 year old 2nd grader Kazuko
5th grade 1st Class Semen Duty with 10 year old 5th grader Misaki
Lolita Angel Prostitution with 10 year old 4th grader Yui
translation:

包括：9岁四年级生九海的初次性经历；11岁五年级日和在小学遭到强奸；10岁五年级日向的兜裆布故事；7岁二年级生葵熟睡时遭到强奸；12岁六年级生二菜的私人辅导；10岁蒂欧的萝莉重生；8岁三年级生八千穗在公共交通工具上遭到轮奸；11岁六年级生三沙的偏远神社传统；9岁三年级生美羽前往公共浴场；8岁二年级生和子夜访孤儿院；10岁五年级生美咲的五年级一班精液值日；10岁四年级生结衣的萝莉天使卖春。
